decisionsTitle: Mailgun is the recommended road for the site's forms, the default of a form with none saved, and «Scrie-ne» gets its road
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-15 ~13:25:** «cum ar fi cel mai bine să trimitem astfel de emailuri? Mailgun sau Gmail? ar trebui în configs să scriu (recomandat)». The answer was Mailgun; the owner's ask is the word in the settings. This amends §772 (the per-form pair «Prin ce trimitem»), §778 (the visitors' messages through the outbox, failover between the two roads) and §149 (the contact form «Scrie-ne»).

**Why Mailgun.** A message leaves from the club's own verified domain with SPF and DKIM and the person's address as `Reply-To`; **no copy** of an anonymous message stays in the club's Sent folder, and it reaches the club's mailbox as mail from outside, not as «from me to me» — the case of 2026-10-15, when a Gmail filter filed the club's own test messages out of the Inbox; delivery status comes by webhook; there is no Gmail app password for Google to revoke and no ceiling of about 500 a day; and the club is on Mailgun's paid plan since 2026-10-01. Gmail stays the road behind it, and the failover of §778 still carries a message the first road cannot.

**Decision.**

1. In «Setări» → «Spune-ne ceva» the Mailgun choice reads «Mailgun (recomandat)» / «Mailgun (recommended)», with **one line of why under the four pairs, once per card**: «Mailgun pleacă de pe domeniul clubului, cu adresa persoanei ca Reply-To, fără nicio copie în folderul „Trimise” al clubului; Gmail rămâne drum de rezervă acolo unde e permis.» The Gmail choice says plainly that a copy of the message stays in the club's «Trimise» folder, and a form **left on Gmail** carries a quiet caption, «Prin Gmail rămâne o copie în „Trimise”.» — words only, no task row. Girl Zone, whose own note already says the stronger thing (the readers of the mailbox see her message), has no second caption.
2. **The default of a form with no saved road** — a fresh install, a new form, a row saved before §772 — is Mailgun where it transmits (`feedbackRoads().mailgun`) and the club's Gmail where it does not, which is what the three ordinary forms did before; Girl Zone stays on Mailgun everywhere (her Gmail road needs the notice's words, §772). `defaultViaFor` is the one function, read where the row is read (`readFeedbackSettings(db, roads)`), so the card, the offer and the send all see the same road. **A road the club saved is never replaced by a release**; saving a card writes what it shows, as before.
3. **«Scrie-ne» (§149) had no road setting** — §778 queued it always on Gmail — so it gets the same pair, with the same words, once, in «Pagini» → «Contact» → «Cine primește mesajele de contact». The road is an optional key `via` of the existing `contactRecipients` row (no migration: `platform_settings` is a key-value store), absent on every row saved before, and read as the default of point 2. A save that does not post it (a greyed radio is never posted) keeps what was saved; a road the deployment lacks cannot be newly chosen, and the audit row says the road as a word. The send queues the message on the chosen road, with the other road as the failover; a chosen road this deployment does not have is replaced by the one it has.
4. **One component draws the pair** (`feedback/ui/RoadChoice.tsx`), so the two cards cannot drift apart; the words are the same keys.

**Open points decided (the owner's standing word is «YOLO»).** (a) A form with no saved road changes road on release where Mailgun transmits — that is the point of «recomandat» and of the default; a form whose road was saved does not, and neither does a deployment where Mailgun does not transmit. For «Scrie-ne» this means production's contact form, with nothing saved, goes by Mailgun after this release; the owner who wants the old road chooses «Gmail-ul clubului» in the same card. (b) The caption is on the three ordinary forms and «Scrie-ne», not on Girl Zone. (c) A road saved while Mailgun was not transmitting stays saved: the club chose it by saving. (d) «Scrie-ne» is still offered only where the club's Gmail road exists (`CONTACT_FORM_MODE`); letting a Mailgun-only deployment show it is a separate change.

**Refused.** A toggle (a choice is radios); a per-message road; a migration or a table for one word; a banner or a task row for the caption. The privacy notice's template is **not** refused: it said «Scrie-ne» goes by Gmail with Mailgun only when Gmail is down, which stops being true when Mailgun becomes its default, so its «Scrie-ne» paragraph now names both roads, as the paragraph on the anonymous forms does (template only: the text in force moves when the club approves it).

**Also reworded** (review, same branch): the «Cine primesște mesajele de contact» card's intro and sender sentence no longer say the messages leave by Gmail, the «Sarcini» row «Formularul de contact» says the form needs the club's Gmail account to be shown (not that the messages go by Gmail), «Trimise» is quoted one way across the road words, and the glue that joins the saved road to the queued message is a pure function (`withContactRoad`, `contact/domain/recipients.ts`) with its own test.
changelogLine: - **Mailgun is «recomandat» for the site's forms** — «Prin ce trimitem» marks Mailgun as the recommended road with one line of why under the pairs, a form left on Gmail says a copy stays in the club's mailbox, a form with no saved road now defaults to Mailgun where it transmits, and «Scrie-ne» has the same pair in «Cine primește mesajele de contact». A saved road is never changed. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 62. Given the card «Spune-ne ceva» and the card «Cine primește mesajele de contact» on «Pagini» → «Contact», when an Administrator reads them, then each draws the same pair «Prin ce trimitem» as two native radios from one component, the Mailgun choice reading «Mailgun (recomandat)» / «Mailgun (recommended)» and the Gmail choice saying that a copy stays in the club's «Trimise»; the card of the four forms carries one line of why under the four pairs and the contact card one under its own pair, a form left on Gmail (except Girl Zone) carries the caption «Prin Gmail rămâne o copie în „Trimise”.», and every sentence is in both languages (2026-10-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criteria 62 and 64. Given a form of «Spune-ne ceva», or «Scrie-ne», with no saved road, when the setting is read, then its road is Mailgun where Mailgun transmits and the club's Gmail where it does not, Girl Zone's Mailgun either way, and a road the club saved is read as saved and never replaced by this default; «Scrie-ne» keeps its road in the optional key `via` of the `contactRecipients` row (no migration), keeps it when a save does not post one, refuses to newly choose a road the deployment lacks, audits it as a word, and queues its message on the chosen road with the other as the failover (2026-10-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: Mailgun recommended for the site's forms
